objective: Experiment: exhaustive census of all 2^27 triangle relations on three labels (functions or not) and all 4^16 multiplication tables on four labels under the ordered 2-3 and 1-4 identities. Frozen predictions: every surviving relation reduces, after deleting triangles in no allowed tetrahedron, to one of seven laws, each a groupoid law pulled back along fibres of equal size (one, two or three constant labels, Z2, Z3, free on two or on three labels); every surviving table reduces to a groupoid (Z4, Z2 x Z2, the pair groupoid, one or two constant labels), as ticket A predicts.
status: Closed: supported under its frozen rule. PATTERN-3D-20261025-001B-E001 tested all 2^27 triangle relations on three labels and all 4^16 multiplication tables on four labels under the ordered 2-3 and 1-4 moves. The 7,948 surviving relations reduce to seven laws, each a groupoid law pulled back along classes of equal size (one, two or three constants, Z2, Z3, free on two or three labels); the 14,284 surviving tables reduce to groupoids (Z4, Z2 x Z2, the pair groupoid inside 12 non-associative Latin squares, one or two constants inside junk labels), as ticket A predicts. Controls passed (no disagreement with the independent law test on 4,811 rules) and the independent re-check reproduced the verdict.
title: Complete censuses on three and four labels
